fields.Name: Committees: Visible Votes
fields.Description: A vote the caller cast (their linked Person holds the membership), every vote on a motion that has no ballot (roll calls taken in a meeting), and every vote on a ballot that is Closed or Cancelled and not sealed. A sealed ballot never shows another member's choice, in any status. Parenthesised so it ANDs onto any other filter the caller holds.
fields.FilterText: (MembershipID IN (SELECT m.ID FROM [__mj_BizAppsCommittees].[vwMemberships] m INNER JOIN [__mj_BizAppsCommon].[vwPeople] p ON p.ID = m.PersonID WHERE p.LinkedUserID = TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)) OR MotionID NOT IN (SELECT b.MotionID FROM [__mj_BizAppsCommittees].[vwBallots] b WHERE b.MotionID IS NOT NULL) OR MotionID IN (SELECT b.MotionID FROM [__mj_BizAppsCommittees].[vwBallots] b WHERE b.Status IN (N'Closed', N'Cancelled') AND b.IsSealed = 0))
